rationale: Thomas brings applied ML expertise from Intuit's production systems, while Elior is conducting cutting-edge ML research at Harvard with published work on computer vision and post-training methods. They can exchange perspectives on bridging research innovations (semantic-structural learning, synthetic datasets) with real-world ML applications, offering Thomas insight into emerging techniques and Elior exposure to deployment constraints at scale.
intro_message: Thomas, meet Elior Benarous — an ML researcher at Harvard focused on computer vision and post-training methods who could offer fresh research perspectives on the applied ML challenges you're solving at Intuit.
